An Exciting Announcement From Harbinger’s Daily

By Breanna Claussen
October 8, 2026
Twitter
Facebook
Telegram
WhatsApp
Email
Print
    (Photo: CommonSpace Images)
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 2:16
    Instaread

    Under the leadership of radically Liberal governments, Canada has transformed into a nation directly hostile to Biblical truth, successfully laying the legislative groundwork for the criminalization of passages from God’s Word and, as a result, Christian organizations and ministries.

    While most of our audience and writers are based in the United States, it is a little-known fact that Harbinger’s Daily has been headquartered in Canada.

    Remaining Canadian-based posed an imminent threat to our religious liberty as a ministry, and our ability to freely publish Biblical-centered news.

    After seven years of seeking the Lord, we can now make a long-awaited announcement… Harbinger’s Daily is officially a U.S. nonprofit ministry.

    This relocation would not have been possible without the extraordinary partnership of our good friends at Lamb & Lion Ministries—and the tireless efforts of their President, Tim Moore, to safeguard Harbinger’s Daily in America.

    Harbinger’s Daily reaches over 125 countries daily, delivering an uncompromising Biblical understanding of world events to tens of millions of readers. Incredibly, God has enabled this extraordinary outreach for seven years from within a nation that leads the Western world in the stifling of conservative news organizations.

    God has provided us an incredible foundation. Now, as an American ministry, we can begin building on that foundation. Many exciting announcements are coming. The wheels are in motion, and we are stepping forward in faith.

    We are actively working toward becoming a 501 (c) (3) —and we thank each one of you who would have spent years self-sacrificingly giving to support Harbinger’s Daily without this tax-exempt status.

    In the meantime, our friends at Lamb and Lion Ministries will provide American supporters with the ability to receive tax-deductible receipts for your donations.

    Harbinger’s Daily still needs your prayer and support — If you would like to give to support the relocation of this ministry, click here.

    We hope that you are praising the Lord with us for this tremendous blessing.

    God bless you, our partners. And may God bless the United States of America!

    Maranatha!

    Breanna Claussen is the Founder, President, and Editor-in-Chief of Harbinger’s Daily, working with ministries across the globe to educate and equip believers to stand boldly with a Biblical worldview.

    Watch my official announcement with Lamb & Lion President Tim Moore:

    TOP STORIES

    Israel & Middle East

    Weaponized Against Israel: Is Antisemitism The New Requirement To Win The Nobel Peace Prize?

    Antisemitism continues to become normalized on so many levels, and it is also gaining momentum to soon become state-sponsored. The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize decision will help that transition further. In a world where good becomes evil and evil is praised, it is hard to be a person of good will, let alone a Christian. The Norwegian Nobel Committee is confident in the integrity of Ms. Pillay, so she is the recipient of the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. Once again, the narrative wins over facts. The United Nations is worthless and obsolete, and the Nobel Prize Committee might have joined that woke social club. Next year, maybe all one will have to do is be the holder of the world record for the most time they uttered "Free Palestine" in a year, and they will win.
    Morality

    ‘Nothing Short Of Censorship’: Christian Teacher Dismissed For Expressing Pro-Life Beliefs In Response To Student’s Question

    “If our national education system continues to claim to foster inclusion and tolerance, this must include tolerance of perspectives with which others disagree. In a free and just society, teachers should not be fired for honestly expressing their deeply-held beliefs in response to questions in the classroom. What happened to me is nothing short of censorship, and this precedent cannot be allowed to stand.”

    In A Culture Of Trendy Lies, It Is Time To Speak Up More Clearly In Support Of Israel And The Jewish People

    We must remember our friends and our allies around the world—particularly Israel and the Jewish people, the one distinct ethnic group of people about which God tells us in His Word to bless and to support. In Genesis 12:3, what did God say to Abraham? “I will bless those who bless you.” Yet many people these days, including a lot of Christians, think that it is trendy, intellectual-sounding, or will garner clicks to oppose things all related to the Jews. Anti-Semitism is on the rise around the world. 2025 was designated by the Anti-Defamation League as the deadliest year of anti-Semitism. Three months after October 7th in 2023, anti-Semitism had risen 360%.
